overview.short: Chikmagalur is a much-loved hill station in Karnataka, known for coffee and mullayanagiri.
overview.description: Chikmagalur, in Western Ghats, Karnataka, is one of India’s favourite hill station. Visitors come for its coffee, mullayanagiri, waterfalls, with the best months being Sep – Mar.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Chikmagalur?
faq.a: The best time to visit Chikmagalur is Sep – Mar. Summers are 20–30°C and winters are 11–24°C.

The nearest airport is Chikmagalur / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Mangaluru Central (113 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Chikmagalur?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Chikmagalur at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Chikmagalur?
faq.a: Stays in Chikmagalur start from ₹1,200 per night, with options across 5 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Chikmagalur?
faq.a: The top attractions are Mullayanagiri Peak, Baba Budangiri, Hebbe Falls.
